newsitem.title: USA: THC HomeCare to make one-for-eight split.
newsitem.headline: THC HomeCare to make one-for-eight split.

text.p: THC HomeCare Inc said Monday it will effect a one-for-eight reverse stock split after receiving approval from its board of directors.

THC said the reverse split, which will come into effect on December 24, will reduce the number of common shares to about 530,000. The split will also affect all outstanding warrants and options to acquire common stock in the company, it said.
"The primary reason for the reverse split is to address the concerns of (the stock exchange) NASDAQ and to put the company in a position to continue its NASDAQ listing," it said.
THC HomeCare is an acquisition-oriented home health care company specializing in home infusion therapy, durable medical equipment and respiratory services.
